pairs.summary: FOXF2 and Lhx3 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 11 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; A549 lung adenocarcinoma; HT-29 colorectal adenocarcinoma; K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; ...). Median lift 1.16x, typical spacing ~40 bp between sites. In 10 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. It is enriched in most profiles, so it may reflect general sequence composition of accessible DNA rather than context-specific cooperation. Caution: overlapping sites — the signal may reflect one family/shared motif rather than two distinct factors. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction. Evidence: motif co-occurrence only (ChromBPNet not yet run for this pair).
